Ramesh and Sohan were partners in a firm. Their capital was Rs. 40,000 and Rs. 60,000 respectively. They agreed to admit Aman as a partner for 1/4th share on the term that he brings Rs. 30,000 as capital and Rs. 40,000 as goodwill. Aman paid his capital money but in respect of goodwill he can bring only Rs. 24,000.
From the above information pass necessary journal entries and prepare Partner's Capital A/c and Aman's Current A/c.
What do you mean by dissolution of a partnership firm? What are the provisions of Indian Partnership Act regarding settlement of accounts at the dissolution of a partnership firm?

Kalyan Company offered 10000 shares of Rs. 10 each payable as Rs. 3 on application, Rs. 2.50 on allotment, Rs. 2.50 on first call and Rs. 2 on the final call. The public applied for 15200 shares. [illegible] shares were allotted on a pro-rata basis to the applicants of 15000 shares. All shareholders paid the allotment money excepting one shareholder who was allotted 20 shares. These shares were forfeited. The first call was made thereafter. The forfeited shares were re-issued @ Rs. 9 per share Rs. 8 paid up. The final call was not made.
Pass necessary Journal entries in the book of Kalyan Company.
What do you mean by 'Private Company' and 'Public Company'? Distinguish between Private Company and Public Company.
